body_markdown:
## Global apparel manufacturer combines Rimini Support™ and Rimini Watch™ to resolve issues faster, identify risks earlier and strengthen the systems and data powering its manufacturing operations


**LAS VEGAS – November 24, 2026 –**[Rimini Street, Inc.](https://www.riministreet.com/?utm_source=pressrelease&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=PtPanBrothersClientStory) (Nasdaq: RMNI), the Software Support and Agentic AI ERP Company™ and the leading third-party support provider for Oracle, SAP and VMware software, today announced that PT Pan Brothers Tbk, one of Indonesia’s largest apparel manufacturers, has selected[Rimini Support™](https://www.riministreet.com/solutions/sap/?utm_source=pressrelease&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=PtPanBrothersClientStory) and[Rimini Watch™](https://www.riministreet.com/solutions/support-services/monitoring/?utm_source=pressrelease&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=PtPanBrothersClientStory) to strengthen the reliability, performance and visibility of its mission-critical SAP environment. The services help PT Pan Brothers Tbk resolve issues faster, identify risks earlier, keep manufacturing operations running strong and deliver the trusted data needed to advance its Industry 4.0 strategy.


Founded in 1980,[PT Pan Brothers Tbk](https://www.panbrotherstbk.com/) produces high-complexity technical and lifestyle apparel for more than 30 global brands, including Adidas, Uniqlo, Lululemon and The North Face. Its SAP S/4HANA and SAP HANA Database act as the digital backbone for finance, production planning, procurement, warehousing, shipping and other essential business functions, making system stability and trusted data essential to efficient manufacturing operations.


“Our industry operates on thin margins, making reliable data essential to better decisions,” said Anne Patricia Sutanto, vice CEO, PT Pan Brothers Tbk. “Rimini Street helps keep our SAP environment stable and well supported, giving us confidence in the data and analytics that drive our business.”


### From Faster Resolution to Earlier Intervention


PT Pan Brothers Tbk selected Rimini Street to combine responsive expert support with proactive system monitoring of its SAP operations. Rimini Support provides direct access to experienced engineers who address issues affecting critical business processes, while Rimini Watch continuously monitors the SAP environment to help identify potential problems before they disrupt operations.


Together, Rimini Watch provides earlier visibility into system health and emerging risk, while Rimini Support provides the expertise to investigate root causes and take corrective action. This helps PT Pan Brothers Tbk move beyond reacting to problems toward preventing them.


The combined approach is already delivering results. Rimini Street engineers traced a persistent SAP configuration issue to its source and recommended changes that helped shorten PT Pan Brothers Tbk’s monthly financial close. Rimini Watch also monitors critical indicators, including CPU and memory utilization, giving the IT team greater visibility to identify risks before they affect factories or other essential business functions.


“Manufacturers need a reliable digital foundation for today’s operations and tomorrow’s innovation,” said Nancy Lyskawa, chief client officer, Rimini Street. “By combining deep SAP expertise with proactive monitoring, we help PT Pan Brothers Tbk resolve issues faster, see potential risks sooner and improve the resilience of its SAP operations. That frees its IT team to spend less time reacting to problems and more time advancing strategic AI and Industry 4.0 priorities.”


### Building a Stronger Foundation for Digital Manufacturing


With stronger SAP operations and greater confidence in its business data, PT Pan Brothers Tbk is advancing digitalization, analytics, automation and AI initiatives while preparing for evolving industry requirements, including[Digital Product Passport regulations in the European Union](https://single-market-economy.ec.europa.eu/single-market/digital-product-passport_en) .


“Our digitalization and database strategy gives us confidence that each garment produced has all of the correct information,” said Sutanto. “With Rimini Street as our partner, we are better prepared for the digital passport, and if those regulations deepen, we trust that Rimini Street can help ensure that we stay ahead of the competition.”


[Read the full client success story](https://www.riministreet.com/clients/pt-pan-brothers-tbk/?utm_source=pressrelease&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=PtPanBrothersClientStory) to learn how PT Pan Brothers Tbk uses Rimini Street services to improve system performance, strengthen operational stability and prepare for digital manufacturing, AI and new regulatory requirements.
